title: Rehearsal Room
subtitle: Practice your salary negotiation with an AI partner. The more you rehearse, the more you earn.
scenarios_subheading: Select a situation to practice. Your AI partner adapts to each one.
scenario_ask_raise_desc: Practice asking your manager for a salary increase after a strong performance period.
scenario_negotiate_offer_desc: Counter a job offer with confidence, data, and a clear ask.
scenario_handle_deflection_desc: Practice pushing back when your manager says now is not the right time.
scenario_negotiate_promotion_desc: Make the case for a title change and a salary increase at the same time.
mic_prompt_body: RaiseHER can listen to your spoken responses so you can practice out loud. You can also type your answers at any time.
mic_not_supported: Voice mode is not available in this browser. Type your responses below.
mic_permission_denied_body: You can still practice by typing your responses.
mic_permission_body: RaiseHER uses your microphone only during rehearsal sessions.
scorecard_subtitle: Here is how your rehearsal went. Research shows that even one practice session increases real-world outcomes.
no_sessions: No sessions yet. Choose a scenario above to start your first rehearsal.
